resources.string: Draw your usual signature. Behavior is an additional signal; only system biometrics can confirm this demo action.

For a matching signal, first enroll Signature via Dialog → Behavior. Without a profile, the signal is unavailable and system biometrics are still required. Android 9 or later is required for this demo.
Draw a fresh signature to begin.
Demo action confirmed by system biometrics.
System biometrics did not confirm the action. Check system enrollment and try again.
Canceled. Start a new signature to try again.
Finish a clear signature with several strokes, or start a new signature.
Input interrupted or expired. Start a new signature.
